analyzer_cross_check.explanation: The frozen analyzer scans the entire historical runs root. Trials without explicit schedule slot/repeat identity are assigned by earliest (scenario, arm) order, so historical submissions can own schedule slots. Its owners therefore differ from the six frozen 4.9 checkpoint owners. Per the assignment, this disagreement is reported as a blocker and is not reconciled by changing either side.

The gate command raises on the first mismatch, premature_handoff_zero.
